exposure.needed: whether the environment has custom setups that depend on reading the statefulset.kubernetes.io/pod-name label from Strimzi pods or Services

original.statement: The statefulset.kubernetes.io/pod-name label has been removed from Strimzi-managed pods and external listeners Kubernetes Services; custom setups depending on this label should use strimzi.io/pod-name instead.

of.needed: which other custom setups (external tooling, scripts, monitoring) read the statefulset.kubernetes.io/pod-name label from Strimzi pods or external listener Services

corrected.statement: Strimzi 0.46.0 no longer sets the statefulset.kubernetes.io/pod-name label on pods and external listener Services. Exposed: environments whose Services or NetworkPolicies select on that label, and other custom setups (tooling) that read it; these should use strimzi.io/pod-name instead.

decision.reason: [ev-4fdefdd841ec] says the operator stops adding the `statefulset.kubernetes.io/pod-name` label to pods and external listener Services, and that custom setups using it should switch to `strimzi.io/pod-name`. Custom setups normally rely on a label through selectors in manifests, such as a custom Service's spec.selector or a NetworkPolicy's podSelector. Static configuration can show those, so this part of exposure is not runtime-only. Only other tooling that reads the label falls outside configuration, and the evidence does not list those setups. That part stays as an undecidable operand alongside the selector predicates, not as the whole condition.
